content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: leases aircraft and engines, sells used serviceable parts, and repairs components for airlines and lessors."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Casino management is a different business; its aviation work is business-jet modification, not engine leasing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO supply distributor serving manufacturers, not an aircraft engine lessor or engine repair business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures asphalt plants for road builders; no aviation, leasing or engine repair overlap."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"In-flight connectivity and internet service for aircraft; does not lease or repair engines or sell engine parts."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Designs and sells avionics such as flight displays and autopilots, not engines, engine leasing or engine repair."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Diversified industrial pumps, valves and friction products; aerospace is a minor end market, with no engine leasing."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Rents gas compressors to oil and gas producers; similar rental model, but different equipment, customers and end market."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures engines sold to equipment makers for industrial uses; does not lease engines or serve aviation."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical fluids and lubricants for industrial plants; no aircraft, leasing or engine maintenance business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Builds and leases railcars with maintenance; similar leasing model, but rail assets and railroad customers differ from aircraft engines."}]}
